sourceAudio: User-supplied 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい / Yuzuki Yukari, UtataP (Original) 320k MP3
method: Video audio is used only to locate the arcade edit. All output samples come from the supplied clean MP3. Band-limited (150-4000 Hz) 1 s waveform correlation gives four constant offsets whose differences are 96, 32 and 98 beats at 142 BPM; 60 ms correlation places each cut on a beat at source 42.7855 s, 90.1119 s and 110.8115 s (cuts inside repeated phrases are estimates). The MP3 ends naturally at about 222.3 s, matching the recording. This is a reconstruction of the arcade edit, not an official audio file.
